# NapMem repository index

> Python memory pyramid: source logs → records → tracks → profiles.

## Source and validation
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml): GitHub Actions validation workflow
- [llm_extraction_prompts.py](llm_extraction_prompts.py): LLM Zero-Fabrication Extraction Prompts & Guardrails for Memory Distillation
- [llm_extractor.py](llm_extractor.py): LLM Extraction Pipeline (production path for the NapMem distiller)
- [memory_pyramid_distiller.py](memory_pyramid_distiller.py): Memory Pyramid Distiller (NapMem + Document Distiller Integration)
- [memory_pyramid_schema.json](memory_pyramid_schema.json): JSON configuration, schema, index or example data
- [napmem_adapters.py](napmem_adapters.py): Explicit offline source adapters and bounded, portable memory export.
- [napmem_cli.py](napmem_cli.py): Portable NapMem commands. Default operation is local, offline and explicit.
- [napmem_config.py](napmem_config.py): Portable TOML configuration with explicit CLI > environment > file precedence.
- [napmem_controls.py](napmem_controls.py): Pure operator controls that persist across extraction replay and alias promotion.
- [napmem_eval.py](napmem_eval.py): Offline evidence-retrieval evaluation, independent of answer generation.
- [napmem_evidence.py](napmem_evidence.py): Bind literal source passages to the exact text supplied to extraction.
- [napmem_inspector.py](napmem_inspector.py): Read-only, scoped memory views and complete-hunk source differences.
- [napmem_jobs.py](napmem_jobs.py): Durable extraction jobs with leases and idempotent canonical commits.
- [napmem_mcp_failover.py](napmem_mcp_failover.py): NapMem MCP failover proxy (stdio)
- [napmem_mcp_server.py](napmem_mcp_server.py): NapMem MCP Server (stdio)
- [napmem_metrics.py](napmem_metrics.py): Private, content-free local metrics and read-only operational status.
- [napmem_model.py](napmem_model.py): Pure, versioned assertion context and derived views for NapMem stores.
- [napmem_retrieval_agent.py](napmem_retrieval_agent.py): NapMem Active Retrieval Agent
- [napmem_search.py](napmem_search.py): Offline scoped retrieval with complete-entry JSON budgets.
- [napmem_snapshots.py](napmem_snapshots.py): Checksummed store exports and atomic publication of complete mirror generations.
- [napmem_sources.py](napmem_sources.py): Bounded source snapshots and a persistent, rename-aware source registry.
- [napmem_storage.py](napmem_storage.py): Private atomic JSON snapshots and reentrant, bounded single-host writer locks.
- [naptime_consolidator.py](naptime_consolidator.py): Naptime Async Memory Consolidator
- [ollama_extractor.py](ollama_extractor.py): ollama_extractor.py — zero-API-cost LLM extraction via local Ollama chat
- [pyproject.toml](pyproject.toml): Repository configuration or supporting file
- [scripts/repo_docs.py](scripts/repo_docs.py): Generate static repository maps, or check their exact content without writes.
- [scripts/run-naptime.sh](scripts/run-naptime.sh): Naptime consolidator wrapper — portable (macOS launchd + Linux systemd).
- [semantic_index.py](semantic_index.py): Semantic Embedding Index for the NapMem Pyramid
- [test_napmem_adapters.py](test_napmem_adapters.py): Synthetic, offline source interoperability and control-replay acceptance.
- [test_napmem_cli.py](test_napmem_cli.py): Portable configuration and CLI behavior against synthetic temporary stores.
- [test_napmem_controls.py](test_napmem_controls.py): Pure replay, deletion-family and operator-preview tests.
- [test_napmem_controls_integration.py](test_napmem_controls_integration.py): Operator controls remain effective across ingestion, cache and reload boundaries.
- [test_napmem_eval.py](test_napmem_eval.py): Deterministic, network-free evidence scorer and benchmark contract tests.
- [test_napmem_evidence.py](test_napmem_evidence.py): Offline tests for literal source binding and explicitly allowed file checks.
- [test_napmem_evidence_extraction.py](test_napmem_evidence_extraction.py): Offline checks for exact extraction inputs and untrusted model quotations.
- [test_napmem_evidence_forget.py](test_napmem_evidence_forget.py): Forgetting erases literal source evidence without deleting unrelated facts.
- [test_napmem_extensions.py](test_napmem_extensions.py): Tests for the production-path extensions: LLM extractor parsing/validation,
- [test_napmem_failover.py](test_napmem_failover.py): Tests for napmem_mcp_failover.py — the remote-SSH / local-mirror MCP proxy.
- [test_napmem_inspector.py](test_napmem_inspector.py): Offline operator inspection, provenance boundaries and exact budgets.
- [test_napmem_jobs.py](test_napmem_jobs.py): Offline durable queue, lease, cloud-resume and atomic-commit tests.
- [test_napmem_lifecycle.py](test_napmem_lifecycle.py): Integration gates for compatible scoped assertion ingestion.
- [test_napmem_mcp_contract.py](test_napmem_mcp_contract.py): Typed MCP contracts, strict pre-load validation and complete wire budgets.
- [test_napmem_metrics.py](test_napmem_metrics.py): Content-free local metrics, retention and strictly read-only status tests.
- [test_napmem_model.py](test_napmem_model.py): Pure scoped assertion, migration and derived-view tests.
- [test_napmem_optional_client.py](test_napmem_optional_client.py): Offline core acceptance with the optional Ollama package made unimportable.
- [test_napmem_pipeline.py](test_napmem_pipeline.py): Integration test for NapMem + Document Distiller Memory Pipeline
- [test_napmem_protocol.py](test_napmem_protocol.py): Offline regressions for the stdlib MCP protocol boundary.
- [test_napmem_provenance.py](test_napmem_provenance.py): Source proof, profile admission and explicit re-verification at public boundaries.
- [test_napmem_regressions.py](test_napmem_regressions.py): Offline regression checks for store reconciliation and disposable caches.
- [test_napmem_retrieval_contract.py](test_napmem_retrieval_contract.py): Public retrieval adapters preserve scope, offline defaults and budgets.
- [test_napmem_safety.py](test_napmem_safety.py): Offline regressions for prompt CPU bounds and wrapper filesystem safety.
- [test_napmem_search.py](test_napmem_search.py): Offline search safety, ranking and exact serialized-budget tests.
- [test_napmem_snapshots.py](test_napmem_snapshots.py): Offline snapshot, checksum and atomic mirror generation tests.
- [test_napmem_sources.py](test_napmem_sources.py): Offline stable identity, guarded collection and source lifecycle tests.
- [test_napmem_transactions.py](test_napmem_transactions.py): Single-host writer isolation, commit boundaries and stale-reader privacy.
- [test_napmem_trusted_loop.py](test_napmem_trusted_loop.py): Actual offline CLI/MCP loop from scoped sources through correction and restore.
